description.p: Lectern is a calm audiobook player for the books you already own. Point it at a folder and it finds your books, their chapters and their covers, and remembers exactly where you stopped in each one. No accounts, no cloud, nothing watching what you listen to.

ul.li: M4B, M4A, MP3, Ogg, Opus and FLAC, single files or folders of files, with chapters
Sleep timer with fade-out, +5 minutes, end of chapter, and a rewind when it stops
Two skip sizes, playback speed from 0.5× to 3× and skip silence
Bookmarks with notes, and undo after a big jump
Volume boost, voice clarity and night mode for quiet or uneven recordings
Covers found automatically from iTunes, Open Library and Google Books
Cast to Chromecast and Google TV devices on your network
Listening stats, media keys and desktop media controls

screenshot.caption: Your library, with covers found automatically

ul.li: Two skip sizes: big skip buttons (1 minute) and a small pair (15 seconds) under them
Sleep timer can rewind to where it started, so you can re-hear what you dozed through
